method.point_estimate: Equal-weight mean of condition-wise ratios of repetition mean costs. A single condition uses ratio of means, never mean of per-repetition ratios.
method.resampling: Shared repetition indices across all policies, models and fixed conditions within a study. No resampling of condition identity, families, tasks or cost constants.
method.scope: Conditional simulation/mapping Monte Carlo uncertainty. Excludes uncertainty of measured GUI costs, imputed parameters, benchmark choice and data-dependent protocol selection.
method.coverage: Pointwise percentile intervals. No simultaneous coverage or multiple-comparison correction.
method.small_sample: Eight or ten repetitions give a coarse empirical bootstrap. Intervals should not support fine-grained ranking claims.
method.presentation: Use estimate with [lower, upper] or asymmetric +upper/-lower deviations. Do not replace percentile intervals with a symmetric half-width.

max_condition_mean_ratio_agent.reporting: Descriptive maximum over fixed tested condition means. No worst-case confidence claim.
